description:
[L] Linear Attack 
This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
[LCC] Fighting Lightning 90+
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex or Pokémon V, this attack does 90 more damage.
